parsed.name: SRS570电流前置放大器
parsed.description: SRS570 是一款电流前置放大器，用于将微弱电流信号放大并转换为便于采集的电压信号。该设备适合实验室中对光电探测器、电化学信号或其他低电流水平传感器进行低噪声读出，并支持灵敏度、偏置、滤波和偏移调节。
parsed.description_en: The SRS570 is a current preamplifier used to amplify very small current signals and convert them into voltages suitable for acquisition. It is used in laboratories for low-noise readout of photodetectors, electrochemical signals, and other low-current sensors, with control over sensitivity, bias, filtering, and offset.

actions.description_en: Set the current sensitivity, with optional scaling of the input offset relative to the selected sensitivity.
